intro.text: A lawman from Far Dorest in the Roughs, and a hard one, willing to beat a confession out of a suspect.

items.text: Deadfinger was already a lawman when Wax came to the Roughs, and he taught Wax the basics of the job. As the only lawman in a crowded town, he was kept busy in Far Dorest and seldom worked beyond it.

Deadfinger easily caught Wayne, then sixteen, after Wayne accidentally killed the innocent man he was robbing. He and Wax found the boy hiding in a crawlspace under a house, and Deadfinger hauled him out while Wayne complained of gunfire only he could hear.
For a few years after Wax left to become Weathering's lawman, he, Deadfinger and Miles Dagouter kept up a loose alliance of lawkeepers, which seems to have fallen apart in time.
